rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human society requires a divinely revealed religion and social law, so the first revealed law must have been universal rather than limited to one people.
rows.anchor: فمن الواجب في العناية أن ينزل الله على المجتمع الإنساني دينا يدينون به وشريعة يأخذون بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humanity began as a simple community without consequential disputes; prophets and scripture came later to judge disagreements by truth.
rows.anchor: فبين أن الناس كانوا أول ما نشأوا وتكاثروا على فطرة ساذجة لا يظهر فيهم أثر الاختلافات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The named divine laws begin with Noah's; otherwise scripture would imply either an unmentioned separate law for others or neglect of them.
rows.anchor: وأول ما ذكر من الشريعة هي شريعة نوح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah's mission was universal and his book, containing the law that resolves disputes, was the first revealed book with a sharia; the Book in 2:213 may mean his or the books of the great messengers.
rows.anchor: فقد بان أن نبوة نوح عليه السلام كانت عامة، وأن له كتابا وهو المشتمل على شريعته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reports that Noah's invitation was not universal conflict with the Qur'an.
rows.anchor: ما يدل من الروايات على عدم عموم دعوته عليه السلام مخالف للكتاب

rows.speaker: الإمام الرضا
rows.claim: A report from al-Riḍā says five messengers were the great possessors of resolve, each with a law and book and a mission universal to all other people, prophets and non-prophets.
rows.anchor: وفي حديث الرضا عليه السلام أن أولي العزم من الأنبياء خمسة لكل منهم شريعة وكتاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah's universal mission entails a universal flood; this is the interpretive cue for verses that describe the punishment as covering the earth.
rows.anchor: فإن عموم دعوته عليه السلام يقضي بعموم العذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to take two of every animal kind aboard would be unnecessary for a flood confined to one region, supporting a worldwide flood.
rows.anchor: لو كان الطوفان خاصا بصقع من أصقاع الأرض وناحية من نواحيها

rows.speaker: صاحب المنار
rows.claim: Al-Manar reads Noah's descendants as the survivors relative to his people and says “earth” in his prayer can mean their homeland, as it does elsewhere in scripture.
rows.anchor: الحصر فيهم يجوز أن يكون إضافيا أي الباقين دون غيرهم من قومه

rows.speaker: صاحب المنار
rows.claim: Al-Manar says scriptural appearances and inherited traditions imply Noah's people were then the only humans; all died except his descendants, while the flood covered their inhabited land, unless dry land was then very small.
rows.anchor: لم يكن في الأرض كلها في زمن نوح إلا قومه وأنهم هلكوا كلهم بالطوفان

rows.speaker: صاحب المنار
rows.claim: Al-Manar argues that marine fossils on mountain peaks can result from the formation of mountains in water, since a flood lasting days could not create them.
rows.anchor: الأقرب أنه من أثر تكون الجبال وغيرها من اليابسة في الماء

rows.speaker: صاحب المنار
rows.claim: Al-Manar treats flood geography as historical rather than a Qur'anic doctrinal purpose: the text is not definitive, so contrary geology would not overturn a decisive verse.
rows.anchor: هذه المسائل التاريخية ليست من مقاصد القرآن ولذلك لم يبينها بنص قطعي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī rejects Al-Manar's reading as an unsupported restriction and answers that great waves could carry shells to high mountains and leave them there after the waters receded.
rows.anchor: ففيه أن من الجائز أن تحملها أمواج الطوفان العظيمة إليها ثم تبقى عليها بعد النشف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The animal-pair command strongly indicates that the flood covered all dry lands, or nearly all of them, and that all people then alive drowned; no decisive proof overturns this Qur'anic appearance.
rows.anchor: فالحق أن ظاهر القرآن الكريم - ظهورا لا ينكر - أن الطوفان كان عاما للأرض

rows.speaker: الدكتور سحابي
rows.claim: Alluvial lands were former channels for substantial streams and torrents, even where they are now dry.
rows.anchor: ويتضح بذلك أن الأراضي الرسوبية كانت مجاري ومسايل في الأزمنة السابقة لمياه وسيول هامة

rows.speaker: الدكتور سحابي
rows.claim: The widespread deposits suggest that in the not-distant past torrents may have covered much of the earth's surface.
rows.anchor: وينتج مما مر أولا أن سطح الأرض في عهد ليس بذاك البعيد

rows.speaker: الدكتور سحابي
rows.claim: The scale and varying grain size of the sediments suggest flooding lasted or recurred over hundreds of years, with flows of varying strength.
rows.anchor: لم يحدث مرة واحدة ولا في سنة أو سنين معدودة بل دام أو تكرر في مئات من السنين

rows.speaker: الدكتور سحابي
rows.claim: Horizontal sediments can bend under strong lateral pressure over millions of years into folded mountain chains; intact horizontal strata are among the newest layers, dated here to at most ten to fifteen thousand years.
rows.anchor: لا يجاوز عشرة آلاف إلى خمس عشرة ألف سنة من زماننا هذا

rows.speaker: الدكتور سحابي
rows.claim: New sediments expanded seas and separated former land connections, including Britain from Europe, Europe from Africa, Indonesia from Asia, and North America from northern Europe.
rows.anchor: فمن ذلك جزيرة بريطانية انقطعت في هذا الحين من فرنسا وانفصلت من أوربا بالكلية

rows.speaker: الدكتور سحابي
rows.claim: Internal earth movements redirected water: some coasts emerged even while water covered much of the land, as happened on the southern Khuzestan coast.
rows.anchor: وللحركات والتحولات الأرضية الداخلية آثار قوية في سير هذه المياه

rows.speaker: الدكتور سحابي
rows.claim: Geological evidence suggests unusually heavy rainfall at the start of the current human era, during the flood period, following extraordinary atmospheric changes.
rows.anchor: النزولات الجوية كانت غير عادية في أوائل الدور الحاضر من أدوار الحياة الإنسانية

rows.speaker: الدكتور سحابي
rows.claim: Heat after an earlier cold period acted on residual northern ice, greatly increasing atmospheric vapor and producing unprecedented heavy rain.
rows.anchor: فمن المحتمل قويا أن المتراكم من جمد الدورة السابقة عليه كان باقيا لم يذب بعد

rows.speaker: الدكتور سحابي
rows.claim: Heavy rain on newly formed mountain ranges caused torrents to erode rock, excavate valleys, carry stones and sand downhill, and create new sediment layers.
rows.anchor: نزول هذه الأمطار الغزيرة الهاطلة ثم استدامتها النزول على الارتفاعات والنجود وخاصة على سلاسل الجبال

rows.speaker: الدكتور سحابي
rows.claim: Valley excavation opened underground water stores, releasing springs that joined rain torrents and increased destructive flooding across plains and mountains.
rows.anchor: كان يكشف عن ذخائر مائية في بطن الأرض هي منابع الآبار والعيون الجارية

rows.speaker: الدكتور سحابي
rows.claim: The flood ended when finite underground reserves ran out and rain stopped, after which water drained into seas, lowlands, and emptied underground spaces.
rows.anchor: وبنفادها وإمساك السماء عن الإمطار ينقضي الطوفان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī says this geological reconstruction can fit the Qur'anic descriptions of rain pouring from heaven, the oven boiling, and the command for earth and sky to stop.
rows.anchor: يمكن أن ينطبق ما قصه الله تعالى من خصوصيات الطوفان الواقع في زمن نوح عليه السلام

rows.speaker: بعض جرائد طهران
rows.claim: A Tehran newspaper reported that American researchers guided by a Turkish military man found old ship-like wood fragments 1,400 feet up Mount Ararat, estimated at 2,500 BCE, for testing against traditions about Noah's ark.
rows.anchor: عثروا في بعض قلل جبل آراراط في شرقي تركيا في مرتفع 1400 قدم على قطعات أخشاب

rows.speaker: بعض الباحثين
rows.claim: Some researchers reject Noah's reported age because human lifespans usually remain below roughly 100–120 years.
rows.anchor: لما أن الأعمار الإنسانية لا تتجاوز في الأغلب المائة أو المائة والعشرين سنة

rows.speaker: بعض الباحثين
rows.claim: One proposed reconciliation counts each ancient month as a year, making Noah's 950 years about eighty years minus ten months; the author calls this extremely far-fetched.
rows.anchor: فالألف سنة إلا خمسين عاما يعدل ثمانين سنة إلا عشرة شهور

rows.speaker: الثعلبي
rows.claim: Al-Thaʿlabī calls Noah the longest-lived prophet and says his lifetime was a personal miracle: a thousand years without losing teeth or strength.
rows.anchor: قال الثعلبي في قصص الأنبياء في خصائصه عليه السلام وكان أطول الأنبياء عمرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No evidence proves such a lifespan impossible; simpler early living conditions and fewer stresses and diseases could have allowed some ancient people to live hundreds of years.
rows.anchor: لم يقم حتى الآن دليل على امتناع أن يعمر الإنسان مثل هذه الأعمار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is strange to object to Noah's age in scripture when the same scripture recounts many prophets' extraordinary miracles.
rows.anchor: على أن الاعتراض على كتاب الله في مثل عمر نوح عليه السلام وهو يذكر من معجزات الأنبياء

rows.speaker: القاموس
rows.claim: Al-Qāmūs places Mount Judi in the Jazira region, where Noah's ark came to rest, and says it is called Ararat in the Torah.
rows.anchor: والجودي جبل بالجزيرة استوت عليه سفينة نوح عليه السلام

rows.speaker: مراصد الاطلاع
rows.claim: Marāṣid al-Iṭṭilāʿ locates Judi overlooking Jazirat Ibn ʿUmar east of the Tigris in the Mosul district, where the ark settled after the waters receded.
rows.anchor: جبل مطل على جزيرة ابن عمر في شرقي دجلة من أعمال الموصل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An objection asks why other animals deserved death in the flood if only Noah's people were guilty.
rows.anchor: هب أنه أغرق قوم نوح بذنبهم فما هو ذنب سائر الحيوان الذي على الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author calls this objection weak: widespread death is not always punitive, as earthquakes, floods, epidemics, and plague often kill many, and God has wisdom in what He decrees.
rows.anchor: فما كل هلاك ولو كان عاما عقوبة وانتقاما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humans reason from observed causal laws toward distant conclusions and feel compelled to decide whether the universe has a cause, because the answer changes the meaning and prospects of human happiness.
rows.anchor: الإنسان يجري في حياته الاجتماعية على اعتبار قانون العلية والمعلولية الكلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human nature first asks whether existence has a God, then intuitively affirms a creator who directs beings toward their perfection and receives them back after death.
rows.anchor: وتتلوه نزعة ثانية وهي القضاء الفطري بالإثبات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because people know abstractions through sense and imagination, they tend to picture even a transcendent God in material, bodily terms.
rows.anchor: عوده أن يمثل كل ما يعقله ويتصوره تمثيلا حسيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only God's sincere servants are free of this imagined anthropomorphism, as the Qur'an says of the purified servants whom Satan cannot mislead.
rows.anchor: ما أشذ أن يسمح الوجود برجل قد أخلص نفسه لله سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People translate descriptions of God's transcendence and governance into a bodily image of a human-like ruler above the heavens, seated on a throne and directing the world.
rows.anchor: بصورة إنسان فوق السماوات جالس على عرش الملك يدبر أمر العالم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī says the extant Torah explicitly presents God in this way and says humanity was created in God's image; the Gospels also appear to do so.
rows.anchor: وقد صرحت التوراة الموجودة بأن الله سبحانه كذلك، وأنه تعالى خلق الإنسان على صورته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is natural, especially for early people, to create a bodily image for a transcendent God; the Trinity can be pictured as a three-faced person, each face representing an attribute.
rows.anchor: كما يمثل الثالوث بإنسان ذو وجوه ثلاثة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Recognizing a powerful creator naturally produces worshipful submission under the universal rule that the weak yield to the strong; conscious animals display the same pattern.
rows.anchor: لم يكن له بد من أن يخضع له خضوع عبادة اتباعا للناموس العالم الكوني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human submission appears in many relations; inward abasement before perceived power is one kind, and its bodily expression counts as worship regardless of who gives or receives it.
rows.anchor: والعمل البدني الذي يظهر هذا التذلل والهوان هي العبادة أيا ما كانت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This natural tendency to submit cannot be removed unless people learn that the being they thought powerful is actually their equal.
rows.anchor: لا سبيل إلى ردع الإنسان عن هذا الخضوع لاستناده إلى قضاء فطري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Islam argues against worshipping other gods by showing they are created servants like humans and cannot help, see, or hear as people imagine.
rows.anchor: إن الذين تدعون من دون الله عباد أمثالكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The call to worship God alone also rejects humans taking one another as lords; the verse closes by calling for submission to God.
rows.anchor: أن لا نعبد إلا الله ولا نشرك به شيئا ولا يتخذ بعضنا بعضا أربابا من دون الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All strength and honor belong to God, so Islam permits reverence for others only when it leads back to God, as in honoring the Messenger, believers, and divine signs.
rows.anchor: فلا خضوع في الإسلام لأحد دون الله إلا ما يرجع إليه تعالى ويقصد به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because people project abstractions materially and submit before overwhelming power, idolatry persists even in secular societies that honor statues and monuments.
rows.anchor: ولذا كانت روح الشرك والوثنية سارية في المجتمع الإنساني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hundreds of millions still practice idolatry; the author infers that it began with statues memorializing great people, especially after their deaths.
rows.anchor: على أن اليوم من الوثنية على ظهر الأرض ما يبلغ مآت الملايين

rows.speaker: الإمام الصادق
rows.claim: A report attributed to al-Ṣādiq says people first worshipped God; after revered people died, Satan proposed their likenesses as reminders, and a later generation mistook the statues for objects their ancestors worshipped.
rows.anchor: في تفسير القمي مضمر أو في علل الشرائع مسندا عن الصادق عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Historical accounts say households in ancient Rome and Greece worshipped the family head and made an idol for the household after his death; some kings and notables were also worshipped.
rows.anchor: وكان رب البيت في الروم واليونان القديمين - على ما يذكره التاريخ - يعبد في بيته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an mentions Nimrod, who disputed with Abraham, and Pharaoh as rulers worshipped by their peoples; Buddha and Brahmin figures also became idols.
rows.anchor: وقد ذكر القرآن الكريم منهم نمرود الملك المعاصر لإبراهيم عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshipping statues of the dead suggests belief that their spirits survive death and become more powerful and influential after separation from matter.
rows.anchor: واتخاذهم أصنام الموتى وعبادتهم لها من الشواهد على أنهم كانوا يرون أنهم لا يبطلون بالموت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh himself was worshipped as a god while also worshipping his own idols, as the Qur'an records his people's complaint about Moses.
rows.anchor: وكان فرعون موسى يعبد أصناما له وهو إله ومعبود في قومه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People avoided depicting God directly because of His transcendence, instead worshipping supposed delegated rulers of particular parts of creation.
rows.anchor: فتوسلوا إلى عبادة الله بعبادة من وكله إلى الله على تدبير تلك الجهة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Communities chose deities for their interests, such as sea gods for coastal dwellers, valley gods for valley residents, and war gods for warriors.
rows.anchor: فالقاطنون في سواحل البحار عبدوا رب البحر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some chose attractive trees or stones as gods; Banū Ḥanīfa made an idol from dried curds and ate it during famine.
rows.anchor: أن بني حنيفة من اليمامة اتخذوا لهم صنما من أقط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Idol worship included blood-smearing and healing rites for diseased livestock, while sacred trees were left uncut and received offerings, vows, and gifts.
rows.anchor: وكانوا يذبحون غنما أو ينحرون إبلا فيلطخونه بدمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most idolaters treated idols as intercessors to obtain good and avert harm; some regarded them as independent gods, and some privileged them over God in offerings.
rows.anchor: أنهم يتخذونها شفعاء يستشفعون بها إلى الله سبحانه ليجلب إليهم الخير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other communities worshipped angels, jinn, fixed stars such as Sirius, or planets, hoping for benefits or fearing harm.
rows.anchor: وكان بعضهم يعبد الملائكة، وآخرون يعبدون الجن، وقوم يعبدون الكواكب الثابتة كشعرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Idolaters usually made a wooden, stone, or metal image for a deity and gave it a human or animal form, even when the supposed god was a star or abstract power.
rows.anchor: عملوا له صنما من خشب أو حجر أو فلز، ومثلوا به ما يتوهمونه عليه من صورة الحياة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They used idols as accessible representations when a god was invisible or too mobile for direct ritual attention, imagining the image expressed its attributes.
rows.anchor: فمن الواجب أن يتخذ له صنم يمثله في صفاته ونعوته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Idolatry broadly treats images as intercessors, but its many schools became so scattered and governed by whim that they resist systematic enumeration.
rows.anchor: اختلاف المنتحلين بها بلغ من التشتت واتباع الأهواء والخرافات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Among relatively organized forms of idolatry are the Sabians, Brahmanists, and Buddhists; the Qur'an also describes idolaters in Noah's, Abraham's, and Moses' eras.
rows.anchor: ومما يمكن أن يعد منها مذهبا قريبا من الانتظام والتحصل مذهب الصابئة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sabian astrology links terrestrial events to the sun, moon, and planets and their associated spirits, which mediate God's rule through endlessly repeating celestial cycles.
rows.anchor: فهي وسائط بين الله سبحانه وبين هذا العالم المشهود تقرب عبادتها الإنسان منه تعالى

rows.speaker: المؤرخون
rows.claim: Historians attribute the Sabian system to the astrologer Yudhāsaf in India under the Iranian king Tahmuras; it spread widely and developed temples, rites, sacrifices, and perhaps human sacrifice.
rows.anchor: وذكر المؤرخون أن الذي أسس بنيانها وهذب أصولها وفروعها هو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sabians affirm God's sole divinity but do not worship Him; they define Him by negations and use divine names metaphorically rather than as real affirmations.
rows.anchor: وهؤلاء يوحدون الله في ألوهيته لا في عبادته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Brahmanism may be among the oldest organized idolatries because Indian civilization is ancient, though its beginnings cannot be dated securely.
rows.anchor: ولعلها أقدمها بين الناس فإن المدنية الهندية من أقدم المدنيات الإنسانية

rows.speaker: المسعودي
rows.claim: Al-Masʿūdī and others say Brahman was the name of India's first king, who settled the land, established civilization, and spread justice; the religion may have taken his name.
rows.anchor: ذكروا أن برهمن اسم أول ملوك الهند الذي عمر بلادها وأسس قواعد المدنية فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Brahmanism likely developed from popular ruler worship; the Vedas comprise writings by religious figures from different periods, later compiled into an organized religion.
rows.anchor: لازم ذلك أن يكون البرهمية كغيرها من مذاهب الوثنية مبتدئة من أفكار عامية غير قيمة

rows.speaker: البستاني
rows.claim: The encyclopedia describes Brahm as the supreme, eternal, absolute source of all things, unchanging and beyond comprehension, who created the universe by the utterance Om, “Be.”
rows.anchor: هو المعبود الأول والأكبر عند الهنود، وهو عندهم أصل كل الموجودات واحد غير متغير

rows.speaker: البستاني
rows.claim: Brahm is also named through a three-person manifestation: Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva; Brahma is the first emanation, with Vishnu and Shiva second and third.
rows.anchor: يجعلون نفس برهم اسما للأقانيم الثلاثة المؤلف منها ثالوث الهنود

rows.speaker: البستاني
rows.claim: In the creation myth, Brahma sits on a lotus amid dark waters until Brahm appears as Bhagavan, grants light and creative power, and gives him dormant beings to unfold.
rows.anchor: فلم ير إلا فضاء واسعا مظلما مملوء ماء

rows.speaker: البستاني
rows.claim: After a hundred divine years of meditation, Brahma creates seven heavens, the death-world, Earth and Moon, and seven lower realms, yielding fourteen worlds.
rows.anchor: فبقي برهما يتأمل في ذلك مائة سنة إلهية

rows.speaker: البستاني
rows.claim: Brahma marries Saraswati and fathers one hundred children after ten sages refuse to help his creative work; Daksha is the eldest.
rows.anchor: فامتنع من مساعدته عشرة منها

rows.speaker: البستاني
rows.claim: Accounts of human origins differ: one has Brahma create Manu and Satarupa, while another derives four social classes from his mouth, arm, thigh, and foot.
rows.anchor: وقال آخرون إن برهما ولد أربعة أولاد وهم برهمان وكشتريا وقايسيا وسودرا

rows.speaker: البستاني
rows.claim: The myth says Brahma fell from creator status through pride, was condemned to hell, and had to incarnate in four ages as celebrated poets and authors to gain forgiveness.
rows.anchor: ظن نفسه نظير العلي فسقط في ناراك أي الجحيم

rows.speaker: البستاني
rows.claim: Brahma is described in three states: the absolute one, an emanation beginning creative activity, and a human incarnation as sage.
rows.anchor: ففي الحال الأولى كان الواحد الصمد والكل الأعظم العلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Brahma has little public worship in India but one temple; Brahmins invoke him daily, offer water, a flower at noon, and clarified butter in the sacred fire rite.
rows.anchor: وليس لبرهما عبادة عامة في الهند، وله هناك هيكل واحد فقط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Brahma is represented as a long-bearded man holding the chain of beings and a vessel of heavenly water, riding the divine bird hamsa.
rows.anchor: ويمثل برهما بصورة رجل ذي لحية طويلة بإحدى يديه سلسلة الكائنات

rows.speaker: البستاني
rows.claim: The myth makes Brahman's birth from Brahma's mouth the reason he receives the four Vedas; disobedience leads Brahma to marry him to an Asura, mother of the Brahmin priestly caste.
rows.anchor: ومن هذا ولد البراهمة وهم الكهنة المقدسون الذين خصوا بتفسير الفيداس

rows.speaker: البستاني
rows.claim: Brahman, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Sudra are associated respectively with priesthood, warfare, agriculture, and servitude; another source lists merchants and says women and slaves are disregarded.
rows.anchor: وذكر غيره أن البرهمية منقسمة إلى طبقات أربع هم البراهمة علماء المذهب والحربيون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sabians, Brahmanists, and Buddhists teach endless cycles of worlds and reincarnation; souls receive happiness or misery according to their former deeds, while perfected knowers of Brahm escape rebirth.
rows.anchor: والمذاهب الوثنية الهندية وكان الصابئين مثلهم أيضا مطبقون على القول بالتناسخ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Buddhism is presented as a reform of Brahmanism founded by Sakyamuni, whose date of death varies widely; excavations in Gaya support his historical existence.
rows.anchor: وقد انكشفت بها آثار أخرى من تاريخ حياته وتعاليمه التي ألقاها إلى تلامذته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Buddha was a king's son who renounced worldly life, practiced forest asceticism, and began preaching at about thirty-six to free people from suffering through virtuous discipline.
rows.anchor: فعزفت نفسه الدنيا وشهواتها واعتزل الناس في شبابه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Buddha presents one compassionate moral law for everyone, with punishment for wrongdoers and reward for the good, accessible to people of every sex, age, and class.
rows.anchor: وشريعتي شريعة نعمة للجميع، وفيها كالسماء مكان للرجال والنساء والصبيان والبنات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Buddhists describe nature as deceptive emptiness and say this view erases distinctions between people, even making the lowest worm a fellow Buddhist.
rows.anchor: وأن العدم يوجد في كل مكان وكل زمان، وهو مملوء من الغش

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their highest goal is release from suffering and delusion by ending rebirth, which requires purifying the soul even of the desire to exist.
rows.anchor: والغاية القصوى عندهم هي نجاة النفس من كل ألم وغرور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Buddha's Four Noble Truths concern suffering, its cause in desire, its cessation, and an eight-part path of right view, speech, action, livelihood, effort, mindfulness, and meditation.
rows.anchor: وتلك الحقائق الأربع تتعلق بالألم وأصله وملاشاته وبالطريقة المؤدية إلى الملاشاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Buddhist ethics is to avoid evil, do good, and discipline the mind; later ritual, sacrifice, priesthood, philosophy, and mysteries were added over time.
rows.anchor: اجتناب كل شيء ردي، وعمل كل شيء صالح وتهذيب العقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some say Buddha never discussed God, but the author says this reflected his focus on detachment from worldly life, not rejection of a creator.
rows.anchor: غير أن ذلك لم يكن لإعراض منه عن مبدأ الوجود ولا لإنكار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Before Islam, most Arabs were nomadic; settled Yemen also retained a nomadic outlook and borrowed customs and religious practices from neighboring powers.
rows.anchor: كان معظم العرب في عهد الجاهلية بدويين وأهل الحضارة منهم كاليمن في طبع البداوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an depicts early Arabs, including ʿĀd, Iram, Thamud, Midian, and Saba, as idolaters.
rows.anchor: وهم العرب العاربة ومنهم عاد إرم وثمود على دين الوثنية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham settled Hagar and Ishmael at Mecca, built the Kaaba, called people to the religion of Islam, and instituted pilgrimage.
rows.anchor: وبنى إبراهيم عليه السلام الكعبة البيت الحرام ودعا الناس إلى دينه الحنيف وهو الإسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some Bedouins adopted Judaism through contact with Hijazi Jews, while Christianity and Magianism spread in other parts of Arabia.
rows.anchor: ثم تهود بعض الأعراب لمعاشرة كانت بينهم وبين اليهود النازلين بالحجاز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After recovering at a Syrian hot spring, ʿAmr ibn Luḥayy copied local idol worship, brought Hubal to Mecca, and reintroduced idols after the people of Abraham had been called hanifs.
rows.anchor: فطلب منهم صنما من أصنامهم فدفعوا إليه هبل فرجع إلى مكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because Jews, Christians, Magians, and idolaters all honored the Kaaba, travelers carried sanctuary stones away, set them up, and circled them, helping idolatry spread.
rows.anchor: لا يظعن من مكة ظاعن إلا حمل معه شيئا من حجارة الحرم تبركا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Known Arab idols included Hubal, Isaf, Na'ila, al-Lat, al-ʿUzza, Manat, Wadd, Suwaʿ, Yaghuth, Yaʿuq, and Nasr; the latter eight are named in the Qur'an.
rows.anchor: وكان من الأصنام المعروفة بينهم هبل وإساف ونائلة، وهي التي أتى بها عمرو بن لحي

rows.speaker: الصادق عليه السلام
rows.claim: A report in al-Kāfī says Yaghuth stood opposite the Kaaba, Yaʿuq on its right, and Nasr on its left.
rows.anchor: أن يغوث كان موضوعا قبالة باب الكعبة، وكان يعوق عن يمين الكعبة ونسر عن يسارها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another report places Hubal on the Kaaba roof and Isaf and Na'ila on the hills of Safa and Marwa.
rows.anchor: أن هبل كان على سطح الكعبة وإساف ونائلة على الصفا والمروة

rows.speaker: تفسير القمي
rows.claim: Al-Qummi assigns Wadd to Kalb, Suwaʿ to Hudhayl, Yaghuth to Murad, Yaʿuq to Hamdan, and Nasr to Khusayn.
rows.anchor: كانت ود لكلب، وكانت سواع لهذيل ويغوث لمراد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Arab paganism retained Sabian practices such as washing after sexual impurity and Brahmanic astrology; some also held the materialist view that time alone causes death.
rows.anchor: وفيها آثار من البرهمية كالقول بالأنواء والقول بالدهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some identify the claim that only worldly life exists and time destroys us with materialists who deny a creator.
rows.anchor: وإن ذكر بعضهم أنه قول الماديين المنكرين لوجود الصانع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Arab custom mixed Abrahamic practices such as circumcision and pilgrimage with idolatry, naked circumambulation, associating partners in the talbiya, and invented taboos and divination rites.
rows.anchor: وفيها شيء من الدين الحنيف وهو إسلام إبراهيم عليه السلام كالختنة والحج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The divine call has always opposed idolatry and summoned people to monotheism through Noah, Hud, Salih, Abraham, Shuʿayb, and Moses, as also reflected in accounts of Jesus, Lot, and Jonah.
rows.anchor: لم تزل الدعوة الإلهية تخاصم الوثنية وتقاومه وتندب إلى التوحيد
